title: ODA: Observation-Driven Agent for Integrating LLMs and Knowledge Graphs
summary: This community centers on the academic paper 'ODA: Observation-Driven Agent for integrating LLMs and Knowledge Graphs,' published in September 2024. The work is authored by a collaborative team consisting of Lei Sun, Zhengwei Tao, Youdi Li, and Hiroshi Arakawa. The paper proposes a method to integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) with Knowledge Graphs using an observation-driven agent approach.
key_findings: The ODA paper was published in September 2024 and is available on arXiv (arXiv:2404.07677).
The research is authored by four individuals: Lei Sun, Zhengwei Tao, Youdi Li, and Hiroshi Arakawa.
The core contribution of the paper is the development of an 'Observation-Driven Agent' specifically designed to integrate LLMs and Knowledge Graphs.
The work is categorized under the field of Computation and Language (cs.CL).
The paper is cited in the context of other recent works involving LLM reasoning on Knowledge Graphs, such as 'Think-on-Graph' (2024).
